templates.content:
# Polish Checklist

## Build
<!-- Version -->

## Visual Polish
- [ ] Screen shake / camera effects
- [ ] Particle effects on key actions
- [ ] UI animations and transitions
- [ ] Loading screens
- [ ] Menu polish

## Audio Polish
- [ ] Sound effects for all actions
- [ ] Music transitions between areas
- [ ] Ambient audio in all environments
- [ ] UI sounds
- [ ] Volume balancing

## Game Feel
- [ ] Input responsiveness
- [ ] Animation blending
- [ ] Hit feedback / juice
- [ ] Camera feel

## UX Polish
- [ ] Tutorials clear
- [ ] HUD informative but not cluttered
- [ ] Accessibility options
- [ ] Settings menu complete

## Performance
- [ ] Frame rate stable
- [ ] Load times acceptable
- [ ] Memory usage within budget
